pages.raw_title: Limbach - A Mission Critical MEP Solutions Partner
pages.raw_meta: Limbach is a mission critical building systems solutions firm with expertise in the design, prefabrication, installation, management, and maintenance of heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and controls systems.
raw_blocks: A LEADING BUILDING SYSTEMS SOLUTIONS FIRM.

Limbach is your trusted partner for delivering mission-critical systems that support life’s most important moments. We specialize in the systems that make facilities functional, HVAC, plumbing, and electrical, and we ensure they are always ready when it matters most.

With 23 locations and 2,100+ experts, Limbach delivers tailored solutions backed by the resources of a national network. Our teams bring deep technical expertise and a sharp focus on mission-critical building systems, providing the reliability, innovation, and performance your facilities demand.
LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR LOCATIONS
George Washington University Third Party Verification with BEPS Washington, D.C.
HCA Florida Palmetto Emergency Palmetto, Florida
MAKE AN IMPACT WHERE IT MATTERS MOST.

At Limbach, you’re more than an employee, you’re a valued partner in work that has purpose. Whether empowering hospitals to save lives or helping manufacturers power our country, what we do matters and so does how we do it.
Here your voice is heard, your ideas shape our future, and were committed to your growth backed by award-winning training, cross-functional career paths, and leaders who care.
We’re building something unique, rooted in values, driven by purpose, and centered on people. Come be part of it.

pages.raw_title: About Limbach - MEP Building Systems Solutions
pages.raw_meta: Limbach is a building systems solutions firm with expertise in the design, prefabrication, installation, management, and maintenance of heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and controls systems.
raw_blocks: Limbach Holdings, Inc. is a leading building systems solutions firm. We partner with building owners and facilities managers to revitalize and maintain mission-critical mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems—ensuring buildings are always ready to perform when it matters most.
At Limbach, we deliver solutions that support life’s most important moments. By providing reliable, high-performance building systems, we strive to be an indispensable partner to our customers.
Critical systems, ahead of the moment.
We deliver and maintain critical systems that support life’s most important moments.
To be an Indispensable Building Systems Solutions Partner, combining national reach with local presence to deliver proactive solutions for mission-critical facilities.
WE ACHIEVE THIS VISION BY:
National Building Systems Solutions Platform
We are shaping a national presence where owners experience Limbach as a single, trusted provider, delivering consistent outcomes through an integrated, scalable platform.
We envision and deliver customer solutions that rival the sophistication, intelligence, and performance of leading OEM offerings.
We build enduring national relationships through a connected ecosystem of branch locations and partners, operating as one unified network in service of our customers’ most complex needs.
